16823-my-neighbors-stories-of-the-welsh-.title: Stories Of The Welsh People
16823-my-neighbors-stories-of-the-welsh-.creator: Caradoc Evans
16823-my-neighbors-stories-of-the-welsh-.description: A book by Caradoc Evans. Wales is Heaven on earth, and every Welsh chapel is a little Heaven; and God has favored us greatly by choosing to rule over us preachers who are fashioned in his likeness and who are without spot or blemish.

arxiv-2110-06182.title: Topological semimetals without quasiparticles
arxiv-2110-06182.creator: Haoyu Hu
arxiv-2110-06182.description: Abstract The interplay between interactions and topology in quantum materials is of extensive current interest. Strong correlations are known to be important for insulating topological states, as exemplified by the fractional quantum Hall effect. For the metallic case, whether and how they can drive topological states that have no free-electron counterparts is an open and pressing question.

arxiv-2110-12244.title: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
arxiv-2110-12244.creator: Honours Program, Project Report
arxiv-2110-12244.description: Abstract Abstract Datacenters are imperative for the digital society. They offer services such as computing, telecommunication, media, and entertainment. Datacenters, however, consume a lot of power. Improving datacenter operations is important and may result in better services, reduced energy consumption and reduced costs. To improve datacenters, we must understand what is going on inside them.

arxiv-2206-09880.title: Breaking Down Out-of-Distribution Detection: Many Methods Based on OOD Training Data Estimate a Combination of the Same Core Quantities
arxiv-2206-09880.creator: Julian Bitterwolf, Alexander Meinke, Maximilian Augustin, Matthias Hein, Julian Bitterwolf, Alexander Meinke, Maximilian Augustin, Matthias Hein
arxiv-2206-09880.description: Abstract It is an important problem in trustworthy machine learning to recognize out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs which are inputs unrelated to the in-distribution task. Many out-of-distribution detection methods have been suggested in recent years. The goal of this paper is to recognize common objectives as well as to identify the implicit scoring functions of different OOD detection methods.

arxiv-2402-07440.title: Benchmarking and Building Long-Context Retrieval Models with LoCo and M2-BERT
arxiv-2402-07440.creator: Jon Saad-Falcon † , Daniel Y. Fu † , Simran Arora † , Neel Guha † , Christopher Ré †
arxiv-2402-07440.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jon Saad-Falcon † , Daniel Y. Fu † , Simran Arora † , Neel Guha † , Christopher Ré †. Retrieval pipelines—an integral component of many machine learning systems—perform poorly in domains where documents are long (e.g., 10K tokens or more) and where identifying the relevant document requires synthesizing information across the entire text.

arxiv-2403-06662.title: A PDE Framework of Consensus-Based Optimization for Objectives with Multiple Global Minimizers
arxiv-2403-06662.creator: Massimo Fornasier, Lukang Sun
arxiv-2403-06662.description: Abstract Consensus-based optimization (CBO) is an agent-based derivative-free method for non-smooth global optimization that has been introduced in 2017 [ 40 ] , leveraging a surprising interplay between stochastic exploration and Laplace’s principle. In addition to its versatility and effectiveness in handling high-dimensional, non-convex, and non-smooth optimization problems, this approach lends itself well to theoretical analysis.

arxiv-2501-12967.title: Logistic diffusion equations governed by the superposition of operators of mixed fractional order
arxiv-2501-12967.creator: Serena Dipierro, Edoardo Proietti Lippi, Caterina Sportelli and Enrico Valdinoci
arxiv-2501-12967.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Serena Dipierro, Edoardo Proietti Lippi, Caterina Sportelli and Enrico Valdinoci. We discuss the existence of stationary solutions for logistic diffusion equations of Fisher-Kolmogoroff-Petrovski-Piskunov type driven by the superposition of fractional operators in a bounded region with “hostile” environmental conditions, modeled by homogeneous external Dirichlet data. We provide a range of results on the existence and nonexistence of solutions tied to the spectral properties of the ambient space, corresponding to either survival or extinction of the population.

arxiv-2506-03225.title: Multiple-Frequencies Population-Based Training
arxiv-2506-03225.creator: Waël Doulazmi, Auguste Lehuger, Marin Toromanoff, Valentin Charraut, Thibault Buhet, Fabien Moutarde
arxiv-2506-03225.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning’s high sensitivity to hyperparameters is a source of instability and inefficiency, creating significant challenges for practitioners. Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) algorithms have been developed to address this issue, among them Population-Based Training (PBT) stands out for its ability to generate hyperparameters schedules instead of fixed configurations.

arxiv-2509-19210.title: Coupled Dipole Oscillation Enabled Scintillation Compensation in Turbulence-Impacted Laser Beam
arxiv-2509-19210.creator: Shouvik Sadhukhan, C. S. Narayanamurthy
arxiv-2509-19210.description: Abstract The present work develops a rigorous framework for collective dipole oscillations in dense dielectric media by extending the Lorentz oscillator model to include both quadratic (second-order) and cubic (third-order) nonlinear restoring forces. Dipole-dipole interactions are incorporated via the dyadic Green’s function, leading to a nonlocal description of the medium.

arxiv-2602-09574.title: Aligning Tree-Search Policies with Fixed Token Budgets in Test-Time Scaling of LLMs
arxiv-2602-09574.creator: Sora Miyamoto, Daisuke Oba, Naoaki Okazaki
arxiv-2602-09574.description: Abstract Tree-search decoding is an effective form of test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs), but real-world deployment imposes a fixed per-query token budget that varies across settings. Existing tree-search policies are largely budget-agnostic, treating the budget as a termination condition, which can lead to late-stage over-branching or premature termination.

pmc-11436519.title: Regulator of nonsense transcripts 3B is a prognostic biomarker and associated with immune cell infiltration in lung squamous cell and hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-11436519.creator: Pengcheng Li, Mi Zhou, Xiaoli Gan, Chaoyi Yuan, Ganxun Li, Guan-nan Jin, Ze-yang Ding
pmc-11436519.description: PurposeThe characteristic of RENT3B in cancer remains ambiguous. We aimed to study the relationship between RENT3B and immune infiltration in liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) and lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC).Patients and methodsWe investigated the expression levels of RENT3B using ONCOMINE and TIMER databases, and assessed the interrelationship between RENT3B expression and survival using PrognoScan, GEPIA, and Kaplan–Meier plotter.

pmc-11749484.title: Integrated transcriptomic analysis reveals dysregulated immune infiltration and pro-inflammatory cytokines in the secretory endometrium of recurrent implantation failure patients
pmc-11749484.creator: Ping Zhou, Dan Mo, Hanji Huang, Jiaqi Xu, Baoying Liao, Yinxue Wang, Di Mao, Zhonghong Zeng, Ziying Huang, Chao Zhang, Yihua Yang, Yang Yu, Heng Pan, Rong Li
pmc-11749484.description: Recurrent implantation failure (RIF) is a leading impediment to assisted reproductive technology, yet the underlying pathogenesis of RIF remains elusive. Recent studies have sought to uncover novel biomarkers and etiological factors of RIF by profiling transcriptomes of endometrial samples. Nonetheless, the inherent heterogeneity among published studies and a scarcity of experimental validations hinder the identification of robust markers of RIF.

pmc-12987425.title: Navigating COVID-19: Association between public perceptions of preventive measures and delayed or foregone care among young and middle-aged Korean adults in the early phase of the pandemic
pmc-12987425.creator: Jongnam Hwang
pmc-12987425.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has had a profound impact on healthcare systems worldwide, leading to significant disruptions in healthcare services and an increase in delayed or foregone care. South Korea has been no exception. While the importance of public perceptions of COVID-19 and healthcare use has been recognized, how such perceptions shape healthcare-seeking behaviour remains underexplored in the Korean context.

pmc-13101462.title: Secreted factors of Staphylococcus aureus promote co-invasion with Candida albicans by inducing hypha formation and invasion
pmc-13101462.creator: Raymond Pasman, Bastiaan P. Krom, Jianbo Zhang, Stanley Brul, Sebastian A. J. Zaat
pmc-13101462.description: Interkingdom interactions between Candida albicans and Staphylococcus aureus promote lethal dissemination of the bacterium. pmc-13103150.creator: Bregje de Louweren, Max Nieuwdorp, Victor E. A. Gerdes
pmc-13103150.description: Obesity is a major health concern, affecting over 1 in 8 people worldwide. Bariatric surgery (BS) is currently the most effective long-term treatment for morbid obesity. pmc-13291747.description: The Gambusia holbrooki (eastern mosquitofish) reference genome will offer a crucial resource for understanding the evolution and adaptation of invasive freshwater fish species. pmc-13399546.title: AN UNUSUAL PRESENTATION OF A HUGE BILATERAL TUBO-OVARIAN ABSCESS: A CASE REPORT
pmc-13399546.creator: S.A. Adebayo, R.O. Balogun, B.A. Esan
pmc-13399546.description: Introduction:Tubo-ovarian abscess (TOA) is a documented and severe complication of untreated pelvic inflammatory disease. It is a life threatening infection that involves the ovaries, the fallopian tubes, and or any other adjacent tissue with a significant risk of infertility and pelvic adhesions. It is most commonly unilateral.
